command.description: The Expo CLI command: start, export, run:ios, run:android, prebuild. Or macos, which builds the desktop host and opens the app in it, and package, which packages the macOS app: both run ng-native-desktop from @ng-native/desktop.

args.description: Arguments passed to the command as they are.

port.description: Passed as --port: the port Metro listens on, or for macos the one the host loads the app from.

clear.description: Passed as --clear: start Metro with an empty transform cache.
